correctness.rationale: For n>=4, flow conservation between length-three and length-four factor counts forces the first triple of w to equal the reversed last triple. With this condition all nonpalindromic four-factor antisymmetric count differences are (0,-h,h,-h,0,-h), h=N0011−N1100, so one scalar condition suffices. The 8-state de Bruijn transfer with t and t^-1 on 0011/1100 respectively has determinant 1−2z+(2−t−t^-1)z^6 and exactly stated reversed-terminal rational trace; formal t^0 extraction yields displayed square-root OGF. The other radicand 1−2z+4z^6 has no zero |z|<=1/2 by y=2z, |y−1|<=1/16 and Re(y^6)>0 contradiction. Unique singularity z=1/2 yields 1/2(1−2z)^(-1/2) leading term and asymptotic. Directly enumerated all 2^n words n<=12 independently, matching listed a_n and structural criterion; finite tests supplement the algebraic proof.
